answer: Escrowed bonds and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a 2,000-unit bond, a pearl in trust, and joins on an edge from its inviter, one terrace at a time. A beacon lists every edge, so 1,000 fakes form one star cluster. A peer may dispute a suspect; it must prove live work in 12 hours or both bonds burn. Forging 1,000 costs 2,000,000 units. An honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards.
